items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Anyway, he called me from New York. He said, “I’m in the office at Atlantic.”

ctx.x: I can’t think who you’re talking about. I think I know who you’re talking about.
Anyway, he called me from New York. He said, “I’m in the office at Atlantic.”
Are you talking about Tommy Turrentine? You said Tommy.
